title: Strategy Meets Story
readMoreLabel: How we work, step by step
seoTitle: How We Work: From Brief to Live Activation | NOVA
seoDescription: NOVA's four-step process: brief and discovery, creative strategy, experience design, then live execution and measuring what moved people.

blocks.text: Every campaign we build begins with a single question: what feeling do you want people to carry home?
01 — Brief & Discovery
We listen harder than anyone else in the room. Goals, audience, tension — we map it all before a single concept is drawn.
02 — Creative Strategy
Data meets intuition. We find the insight that makes your brand impossible to ignore — then build the story around it.
03 — Experience Design
From a napkin sketch to a full activation floor — every detail is designed to make people feel something real.
04 — Live & Measure
We execute flawlessly, then track what moved — because a great story is only great if people remember it tomorrow.
